gemini.performance_metric: net income attributable to common shareholders of $109.5 million (2019)
gemini.rationale: The slice documents Urban Edge Properties operating successfully as an independent public company five years post-separation, with steady profitability and ongoing portfolio management. There is no evidence of product/process disruption (p4_pathway) or process/organization fracture (p5_pathway) in the realized outcome.

grok.performance_metric: no divestiture; independent going concern; FY2019 NI attr. common $109.5M
grok.rationale: The slice documents UE as an ongoing independent operator of 74 shopping centers, four malls and a warehouse park (~15.2M sf) with ~1,100 leases and reported FY2019 profitability, with no realized product/process misalignment or inability to run the portfolio. Management and organization show continuity (founding Chairman/CEO Olson still signing the FY2019 10-K; 117 employees; headquarters retained) and only routine dispositions/redevelopment, with no documented operations-vs-organization fracture over the window.

openai.rationale: No realized product/process disruption is documented; approximately five years after separation, UE continued operating 74 shopping centers, four malls, and a warehouse park totaling about 15.2 million square feet. No process/organization fracture is documented; UE had 117 employees, continuity of its Chairman/CEO, and remained profitable, with FY2019 net income of $116.2 million.
